original_mechanism: Expanded IPv4-mapped IPv6 text includes a dotted-quad suffix that the legacy byte parser cannot decode on Python 3.13.
synthetic_mechanism: Normalizing a mapped IPv6 address to the underlying IPv4Address drops the 96-bit IPv6 mapping prefix and produces four bytes instead of sixteen.
oracle: Every accepted mapped IPv6 string must yield the literal expected 16-byte IPv6 representation; ordinary IPv6, legacy forms, binary inputs, and invalid-input handling retain their behavior.
realism: A network-address normalization refactor can incorrectly collapse address families, although a packet verifier must preserve the complete on-wire IPv6 identity.
expected_reason: The 16-byte invariant rejects a four-byte IPv4 payload with ValueError. This is a wrong-family binary representation, not the original dotted-text parsing failure.
distinctness: The exact original production fix is retained before the new semantic mutation.
